review_method: Full local extractor read plus targeted original-reader interface read and independent AST-only pin extraction. No source imported or executed by this reviewer; no control rerun. Author local helper controls are source-bound records only.

checks.detail: Exact expected source/audit references equal the MAIN-provided local qualified-source index. Expected reader bytes/SHA equal the complete local final reader. No remote source reopened by this reviewer.

fields uses key membership and preserves explicit null/false. Unavailable stages retain observed=false plus exact reason. Missing transition interval and optional join fields become present=false,value=null.

All five stages retain shape,dtype,bytes,geometry and both availability and logical metadata comparisons. First hash difference and first coverage difference remain separate; no inferred numerical equivalence from unlike tensor spans.

Original core/norm/outproj rows are copied with full131 producer-witness scope, last8 BF16 metrics and their no-threshold/no-qualification flags. Finite or relative-L2 values are not converted into task accuracy claims.

Two generations times five stages with all four rank observations are retained. Unknown equality remains null, distinct TP shards need not be equal, equality_required and numerical_qualification remain false.

Active metadata, roles, calls, exceptions and supported reduction callsites are copied. Weight/bias version or format null values survive unchanged; no weight-content or callee/HCCL/kernel-source proof is claimed. The five runtime-source mapping and rank complete_ref are copied for traceability.

Producer flags are named saved_reader_flags. The extractor rereads only the diagnostic and its own source as complete files, with SHA/size/stat/ancestor identity before/after. Nested readset equality is read from the diagnostic; no nested evidence is reopened.

All saved false qualification flags are required false. Summary status states NOT_GATE; original pair replacement/rerun stay false; first observation is not cause; initial state equivalence is not assumed. The complete original limitations list is copied.
Historical FAIL retains a fixed execution Ref and explicit reopened_by_extractor=false / historical provenance. It is not a new paired evaluation.

Whole input <=32MiB; own source <=128KiB; output <=256KiB; AS <=512MiB,CPU <=30s,FSIZE <=256KiB,core0. Time checks use a60s deadline. No model/reader import, subprocess, service or NPU action; output uses create-exclusive nofollow. Output overflow fails without truncation; actual-output size and runtime success are not established here.
Duplicate keys and nonfinite constants are rejected; finite_float additionally rejects numeric exponent overflow. No missing/null boolean coercion is introduced.

pending: MAIN must supply the exact actual completed diagnostic Ref; this review does not assert its availability or success.
Actual bounded extraction and stable full-file reads must succeed; no output-size claim is inferred from static inspection.
Any later result must retain saved reader interpretation limits and cannot replace the original full-pair FAIL or final acceptance.
